title: savedqueryvisualization
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): createdby, createdonbehalfby, modifiedby, modifiedonbehalfby, organizationid, webresourceid.

canbedeleted.description: Tells whether the saved query visualization can be deleted.

charttype.description: Indicates the library used to render the visualization.

createdon.description: Date and time when the system chart was created.

datadescription.description: XML string used to define the underlying data for the system chart.

enablecrosspartition.description: Tells whether the chart can retrieve data from all cluster partitions.

introducedversion.description: Version in which the form is introduced.

iscustomizable.description: Information that specifies whether this component can be customized.

isdefault.description: Indicates whether the system chart is the default chart for the entity.

ismanaged.description: Indicates whether the solution component is part of a managed solution.

modifiedon.description: Date and time when the system chart was last modified.

presentationdescription.description: XML string used to define the presentation properties of the system chart.

primaryentitytypecode.description: Type of entity with which the system chart is attached.

savedqueryvisualizationid.description: Unique identifier of the system chart.

solutionid.description: Unique identifier of the associated solution.

type.description: Specifies where the chart will be used, 0 for data centric as well as interaction centric and 1 for just interaction centric

versionnumber.description: Version number of the system chart.

_createdby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who created the system chart.

_createdonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who created the system chart.

_modifiedby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who last modified the system chart.

_modifiedonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who last modified the system chart.

_organizationid_value.description: Unique identifier of the organization associated with the system chart.

_webresourceid_value.description: Unique identifier of the Web resource that will be displayed in the system chart.
